name: Block Layers
description: New layered blocks (concrete, sand, leaves, etc) that you place exactly like snow layers.

name: Blocky Doors
description: Adds solid, blocky-style doors that fit exactly matching their source blocks.

name: Coloured Stuff
description: Adds new blocks for each dye color, water, wood, stone, and more

name: Glass Cutter
description: New tool that insta-mines glass and harvests it with no silk tocuh needed.

name: Stonecutter Likes Wood
description: Allows wood and wood products to be processed in the stonecutter.

name: Elementary Ores
description: Adds nether ores and endstone ores to world generation

name: Cyclic
description: Adds way too much content

name: Simple Storage Network
description: Network connected chests for mass storage

name: Ocean Floor Control
description: Configure clay, sand, and gravel features to on the ocean floor, a throwback to old world generation before everything was gravel.

name: Vein Creeper
description: Creepers that convert stone into ore when detonated.

name: Creeper Heal
description: Terrain damaged by creeper explosions gradually heals itself back.

name: Let Them Grow
description: A small mod to slow down growth of crops and livestock.

name: Absent by Design
description: Add stairs, walls, slabs, fences to existing blocks, fully resource pack compatible.

name: AutoRun
description: Client-side toggle to automatically keep running without holding a key.

name: Heart Balance
description: Consumable zelda-style healing hearts are dropped, heals you on pickup.

name: Mounted Pearl
description: Horse will travel with you when you throw enderpearls while riding.

name: No Log Punch
description: Prevents breaking logs with your fist, which changes the early game. Adds one flint tool

name: Stupid Horse Stand Still
description: Saddled Horses stay put when you un-mount them (similar to NoAI) instead of wandering away

name: Phantom Minecart
description: Ads one improved minecart that can travel directly through all other entities and carts like magic.

name: Anti Bonemeal
description: Bonemeal use has been disabled since it lets you dupe wood; its too overpowered.

name: Fragile Torches
description: Torches get broken by gettining walked into by living creatures; adds more survival challenge.

name: Auto Plant
description: Sapling items auto plant themselves they despawn on viable grass.

name: Garden Tools
description: Specialised tools that make tilling, planting, and harvesting faster.

name: Stronger Farmland
description: Farmland, anytime that it is wet, will resist being trampled by players and mobs.

name: Scraps
description: Turn leftover and partial resources into useful crafting materials, junk piles spawn in world.

name: Picky Bags
description: Bags that auto-collect only the specific item types.

name: Enchanting Runes
description: Get early game enchanted goods with a rune-based enchanting system as an alternative to vanilla enchanting.

name: Potato Bread
description: Adds potato bread — a new craftable food with its own hunger values and special effects.

name: cobblestoney
description: Cobbled versions of granite/andesite/etc blocks are dropped, also new stone and mud block variants are added

name: Villager Artifacts
description: Make villagers more useful with many items to use and improve them

name: Tiny Light Bulbs
description: Adds tiny light bulbs in the game, dyeable after you place them

name: Inventory Crafting Grid
description: Inventory crafting is now 3x3
